result:
To find the area of a rectangle, you multiply the width by the length.

**Formula:**
$\text{Area} = \text{width} \times \text{length}$

**Calculation:**
$\text{Area} = 5\,\text{m} \times 7\,\text{m} = 35\,\text{m}^2$

The area of the rectangle is **35 square meters**.
